chapter.verse: I Topa Jesu Khris' hehpihna in note hong ompih ta hen.
Keimah Paul, Silvanus, leh Timothy in i Pa Pasian leh Topa Jesu Khris' sunga om Thessalonica khuamite' pawlpi kong hopih uh hi.
Note' tungah hehpihna hong tung henla i Pa Pasian leh Topa Jesu Khris' kiangpan nopna lemna hong om ta hen.

Sanggamte aw, note na upna uh nakpitak khangin na vekun khatlekhat na ki-itna uh lian semsem ahih manin kote in sep-huai ahihna zui-in note' hangin Pasian' tungah hehpihna ka phat det ding uh a phamawh ahi hi.
Tua hangin na tuahkhak uh bawlsiatnate leh gimnate khempeuh sunga na neih uh thuakzawhna leh upna hangin Pasian' pawlpite' lakah note tawh kisai-in komahmah ka na kisial uh hi.
Gim na thuaklawh uh Pasian' kumpigam tawh a kilawm mi-in note hong kingaihsun ding cih pen a thutang Pasian' thukhenna a kilangkhia thu ahi hi.
Pasian in no hong gimsakte' tungah gimna tawh a thuhkik ding pen thutang khatin mu hi.
Topa Jesu ama' vanmi a thahatte tawh vantung pan hong kilat hun ciangin tu-a gimna a thuak note banah kote zong khahkhiatna hong pia ding a,
Pasian a theilo mite leh i Topa Jesu' Lungdamna Thu a sanglo mite meikuang tawh thukkik ding hi.
Tua mite in tawntung siatcipna tawh kipawl gawtna tuakkha ding uh a, Topa' ompihna leh ama' minphatna vanglian tawh kigamla ding uh hi.
Kote' teci panna hong ki-um ahih manin tua ni ciangin ama' mi siangthote' lakah pahtawi ngah dingin leh amah a na um mite khempeuh ii thupitsakna ngah dingin amah hong pai ding hi.

Hih thu hangin i Pasian in ama' hong sapkhiatna tawh a kilawm mi-in hong ngaihsut nading ahi zongin, a hoih dinga hong deihsak thu khempeuh leh upna tawh kisem khempeuh ama' vangliatna tawh hong tangtunsak nading ahi zongin, note' ading thu ka ngen den uh hi.
